column1: # Every Markdown surface of this repository (repo-root docs, the shipped plugin docs, the root contract and
# roadmap) carries exactly one primary role. A surface may link to another role, but it never presents
# historical state as current authority. tests/test-doc-roles.sh holds this file to the tree and the tree to it.
#   operative-authority   the one place a governed concept is defined; a change here changes the rule
#   current-projection    rendered from a machine-readable authority or the code, checked for parity, or a dated index
#   explanation           why and how; states rules only by pointing at their source
#   historical-evidence   dated record (decision, release, audit, research); never current truth
#   superseded            kept for the record and marked so in its first lines; nothing reads it as current
# Columns: path <TAB> role <TAB> governed concepts (comma list, or -) <TAB> note
